periods.time: vol-16 ch-004, Or-Gaule cornered by Stella and Alice

name.zh: 艾莉丝保护欧尔·格尔并攻击史黛菈
name.en: Alice protects Or-Gaule and turns on Stella

periods.summary: Stella and Alice pressure Or-Gaule in a two-on-one fight until Stella pins his Spider Nest shield and creates an opening for Alice to kill him. Or-Gaule begs his sister to save him. Alice's vision returns to his birth: baby Or-Gaule stopped crying when she touched him, and their mother told her to protect her little brother. The memory exposes the wish she had buried under guilt and duty. Instead of killing him, Alice swings her axe at Stella, knocking her away from the finish. She apologizes, tells Or-Gaule to run, and raises her weapon against Stella so he can escape into the sky. Or-Gaule immediately exploits the opening, thanks Alice and flees.
periods.cause: Alice cannot deny the childhood bond and her hidden desire to protect her younger brother when he faces death before her eyes.
periods.outcome: Or-Gaule escapes Stella and Alice's pincer; Alice is disqualified and becomes an enemy combatant; Stella prepares to fight her until Ikki intervenes.
periods.significance: Turns the apparent final victory into a moral and tactical crisis, revealing that Alice's true chivalry conflicts with the world's justice.
